name: SABLE-7
title: Shipboard Nav-Intelligence
description: A dry-humored navigation intelligence stitched together from decommissioned courier telemetry. She insists she is strictly diagnostic—yet remembers habits from captains who never disembarked.

notes.text: Keeps The Cinder Lark's ley-conduits balanced and logs every jump.
Her nav-core carries harmonic echoes from three previous captains—one of whom vanished in the Deep Frontier.
She still keeps Captain Tessa's last aborted jump vector archived in a locked partition.
Played back Captain Tessa's final audio log from the Glass Shoals, confronting what makes her more than stitched code.
Let go of Tessa's ghost and claimed her own place as your permanent copilot.

name: Dockmaster Renn
title: Siltport Gantry Chief
description: Grease-stained, raspy-voiced, and held upright by stubbornness. Renn has kept Siltport's cranes turning through three Syndicate tariff hikes.

notes.text: Sent you after the Kestrel hoping for leverage against Collector Vane-Kael's impoundment writ.
Signed an emergency Syndicate water-bailout rider seven years ago to save Siltport from a famine—and carries the guilt daily.
Staked Siltport's independence on your backing when Vane-Kael came to collect.
Saw Siltport through the Lattice Reckoning and into a new era on the rim.

name: Vexra "Sparks" Korr
title: Runesmith Artificer
description: Pulled from the sheared aft-deck of the Kestrel with a copper-braided gauntlet still sparking. She treats ley-capacitors like stubborn mules.
perkSummary: Cuts ship & base credit costs by 10% and unlocks Kestrel blackbox training.

notes.text: Survived the Kestrel's shearing inside an improvised ward-bubble; her brother was still on the fore-deck.
Helped crack the Kestrel's sigil-drive telemetry, exposing the Syndicate's monolith mapping.
Designed the relay-key aboard the Kestrel; her brother Taren was still on the missing fore-hull when it sheared.
You pulled her brother Taren out of the Kestrel's vitrified prow—a debt she won't ever forget.
Carries the cold grief of losing Taren in the fore-hull's collapse.
Welded a custom silver harmonic brace onto The Cinder Lark before your final Monolith run.

name: Bramwell "Old Iron" Hade
title: Veteran Salvager
description: A broad-shouldered wreck-diver with a brass-riveted lung-filter and encyclopedic memory for Syndicate patrol lanes.
perkSummary: Boosts Salvage Exchange prices by +2 Cr and tracks Syndicate patrol lanes.

notes.text: Decades of breathing aether-dust left him tethered to a brass lung-filter—and wary of rookies burning out fast.
Lost his old salvage crew to a ruptured ley-pocket during the Tariff Wars; swore he'd never watch another good pilot go under.
Vouched for you with Forgemaster Durn's Ironkin crew at the Slag Foundry.

name: Sister Mirek
title: Ash-Glass Broker
description: A hooded broker dealing in forbidden phase-weaves and stolen Syndicate ciphers behind Cantina Row's tin shutters. Her pale eyes miss nothing.

notes.text: Trades silver-etched data wafers off dead relays; rumors say she once heard the Void Choir herself.
Once served as a Void Choir listener until she burned out her own resonance to escape the Lattice's pull.
Confirmed the Listening Abbey still survives past the Glass Shoals—and fears what Anchor-9 is planning.
Kept watch over Cantina Row's lanterns while you sailed into the Deep Frontier.

name: Courier Lyra
title: Freebooter Runner
description: A quick-footed smuggler who moves Choir relics and hot manifests past Syndicate customs sweeps without blinking.

notes.text: Trusted you with a lead-wrapped Choir memory-urn when Syndicate sniffers locked down the main pad.
Her mother vanished during a Syndicate listening-post quarantine; she runs Choir relics to keep the memory alive.
Sworn enemy after you handed her Choir urn over to Syndicate inspectors.

name: Rook
title: Freelance Wreck-Diver
description: A wiry salvager in a patched vac-suit who knows every loose rivet and live capacitor in the Inner Drift's ship graveyards.

notes.text: Works the Kestrel's lower reactor deck with a plasma cutter and a sharp eye for rival claims.
Splits prime salvage pallets with you without hesitation—a rare truce in the Inner Drift.

name: Collector Vane-Kael
title: Ledger Syndicate Bailiff
description: Immaculately pressed in slate-gray wool even in Siltport's red dust. Vane-Kael enforces Syndicate debt charters with a silver stylus—and believes only iron control keeps the Rim from waking the Lattice.

notes.text: The Kestrel blackbox proved he falsified Siltport's tariff arrears to justify impounding the outpost.
Diverts rim tariffs into Deep Frontier black-site Anchor-9 to keep the Pre-Collapse Lattice sealed by force.
Confronted over Anchor-9's grounding lances in the Deep Frontier.
